entities.summary: Oleh Ivanovych Osukhovskyi is a Ukrainian politician and former professional footballer who served as a People's Deputy of Ukraine from Ukraine's 152nd electoral district, located in Rivne Oblast, from 2012 to 2019. Prior to his election he was a member of the Rivne Oblast Council.
